mapper.select: SELECT FROM mall_order 1=1 AND order_no LIKE concat('%',#{orderNo},'%')AND order_status=#{orderStatus}AND member_id=#{memberId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT FROM mall_order WHERE order_status='PENDING_PAYMENT' AND expire_time < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ORDER BY order_id LIMIT 200
SELECT order_item_id,order_id,sku_id,product_name_snapshot,sku_name_snapshot,sale_price_snapshot,quantity,payable_amount FROM mall_order_item WHERE order_id=#{orderId} ORDER BY order_item_id
mapper.update: UPDATE mall_order SET order_status='CANCELED',cancel_reason=#{reason},cancel_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),update_by=#{updateBy},version=version+1 WHERE order_id=#{orderId} AND order_status='PENDING_PAYMENT'

UPDATE mall_order SET order_status='SHIPPED',logistics_company=#{company},logistics_no=#{logisticsNo},ship_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),update_by=#{updateBy},version=version+1 WHERE order_id=#{orderId} AND order_status='PENDING_SHIPMENT'
mapper.select: SELECT sku_id AS skuId,available_stock AS availableStock,locked_stock AS lockedStock FROM mall_product_sku WHERE sku_id=#{skuId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE mall_product_sku SET available_stock=available_stock+#{quantity},locked_stock=locked_stock-#{quantity},version=version+1 WHERE sku_id=#{skuId} AND locked_stock >= #{quantity}
UPDATE mall_member_coupon SET status='AVAILABLE',locked_order_id=NULL,version=version+1 WHERE locked_order_id=#{orderId} AND status='LOCKED'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mall_inventory_log(sku_id,biz_type,biz_no,available_change,locked_change,available_before,available_after,locked_before,locked_after,operator_type,operator_id,reason) VALUES(#{skuId},'RELEASE',#{bizNo},#{availableAfter}-#{availableBefore},#{lockedAfter}-#{lockedBefore},#{availableBefore},#{availableAfter},#{lockedBefore},#{lockedAfter},'ADMIN',#{operatorId},'订单取消释放锁定库存')
